findings: Record set re-validated with _validate_record_set(ROOT, evidence, documents, record_set, live=True): recordSetSha256=be4835997e360d15470efab4211e4fa0b2719093700f76e4ff4ce09d3099e720 and sourceArtifactsSha256=31965ec3d42ddb2ce2b82a24b89494cadd1109c97980f729520e4f98d703d458 match the on-disk record-set file, and every pinned source byte was re-hashed against BENCH, anchoring this review to the exact reviewed source.

One-time disposition is enforced structurally: apply_disposition runs under PRAGMA synchronous=FULL + BEGIN IMMEDIATE (OperationalError mapped to refusal), performs a conditional UPDATE scope ... WHERE state='INCOMPLETE_UNKNOWN_CHARGE' requiring rowcount==1, and inserts the single DISPOSITION_EVENT requiring last_insert_rowid()==10; validate_history requires exactly one disposition event at index 9 (event id 10).

Backup creation (_copy_backup) opens the destination with O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW at mode 0o600 via dir_fd, fsyncs file and directory, re-hashes the result to the confirmed ledger SHA, and refuses any pre-existing/aliasing backup path (_validate_paths: new_backup must not exist, differ from ledger/old_backup, be direct protected state).

Proof is one-time and non-malleable: _proof_payload/_validate_disposition_event compare canonical JSON (integers distinguished from booleans/floats at every depth), require all six path-hash forms, oldEventCount==9, remainingSlotCount==442, and a self-consistent proofSha256; rehashed/renamed/malformed proofs are rejected (tests: rehashed_malformed/rehashed_proof/malformed_proof_reuse all green).

Native quiescence (f349) is bound independently of caller markers: _quiescence_probe unconditionally injects the four default launcher markers and, in registered-operator mode, appends the pinned native executable to the criteria set regardless of authorization['quiescenceProcessMarkers']; _descriptor_quiescence uses untruncated `ps -axww` plus current-UID `lsof -nP -a -u <uid> -d cwd,txt -F0pfn` and exempts a native process only when its descriptor path exactly equals the pinned native binary, it holds no protected cwd/txt match, and its kernel lstart predates events[1].created by >2s (test_native_inspection_does_not_depend_on_caller_supplied_markers and test_only_a_preexisting_native_outside_protected_workspaces_can_be_excluded pass).

Continuation accounting is sound: validate_history replays the immutable 9-event prefix verbatim, requires exact 'started' event 11, forbids duplicate starts, orders the 442 future terminals against remaining slots (no retry/escape into the two preserved slots), reconciles each future request through the budget admitter, and halts (never 'complete') on any future unknown-charge, budget-refusal, stop, in-flight reservation, or missing collection-complete event.

Permanent $51.04 liability is retained: exposureMicroUsd is required to stay >= 51_040_000 and <= the 1_000_000_000 ceiling, actualCost stays None, futureUnknownPolicy is 'halt', and completion counters fix accountedSlots=444 / continuedSlots=442 / historicalPreservedSlots=2 with the historical request ids and source epoch ids.

Provenance handling matches the actual layout: original-pins-only preserves declared source IDs plus git commit without fabricating archived copies and forces epoch-002 sourceHashes to equal the immutable financial binding harnessArtifacts and the predecessor pins; the epoch-002 invalid reason must end with the frozen marker 'agent output matches error marker: "api error"'; A1's attemptStart path/hash are preserved as paired None (no fabricated first-attempt-start).
Owner binding is enforced: owner is '<sha>.<owner_binding_identity(binding, proofSha256)>' and is re-checked in complete_scope and in read_progress before any completion is reported.

Proposal is strictly separated from activation: ppw-gateway-register-disposition.py --write emits activated:false with the three required final subjects and writes no operational state; write_documents preserves the active analysis bytes exactly (staged os.replace, pre/post byte checks) and refuses when an activation already exists; activate() requires the unchanged old analysis, an unexecuted proposal, the confirmed record-set SHA, and all three genuine final APPROVE raw reviews via validate_final_review, publishes the activation before atomically swapping the wrapper (fail-closed), and never inspects/applies a ledger or starts collection. No activation record, epoch w-rows-pilot-gateway-003, or ledger event 10 exists in this proposal.

Progress reporting is read-only and outcome-blind: ppw-gateway-progress.read_progress opens the ledger mode=ro with PRAGMA query_only=ON, and the emitted record carries outcomeBlind:true, terminalCountersDoNotReportTaskSuccess:true, remainingNonterminalDoesNotMeanUntouched:true, stage2Authorized:false, and accountingComplete decoupled from task success.

Focused SYNTHETIC suites all pass under pinned Python 3.9.6: 42 tests (test_ppw_gateway_disposition, _disposition_registration, _progress) and 119 tests (test_ppw_gateway_disposition_collection, _archive, _diagnostics, _terminal_registration, _native_startup, _model_pins, _registered_collection, _gateway) = 161 green (1 skip), with the collection lane exercising a real collector + HTTP gateway + private ledger under in-memory SYNTHETIC trust roots and no native opt-in flags.
